text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...It slipped through my grasp by a mere 
hair.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yet, I caught its shadow. 
Next time, my blade will not miss.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The rivals around me, the weakness within 
myself— 
I shall cut them all down in a single 
stroke 
and seize the honor of victory!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Mm... 
There is truth in that as well.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To advance forward, acknowledging my own 
strength 
may indeed be necessary.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Reflect upon what was achieved, hone my 
strengths— 
and thus set my sights upon greater 
heights once more.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Indeed, I gladly accept your counsel.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I shall focus on refining my spirit. 
I leave the refinement of my body in your 
hands.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
First, zazen meditation. 
—I must clear away all worldly 
distractions.
